# CloudFormation

Source shape: templates as written by hand and by tooling.
source: handbuilt.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `web_stack.yaml` | Short-form intrinsics (`!Ref`, `!GetAtt`, `!Sub`, `!If`, `!Join`, `!Select`, `!FindInMap`, `!Equals`, `!Cidr`, `!GetAZs`), parameters with defaults, mappings, a condition, a VPC with public and private subnets, three security groups chained by `SourceSecurityGroupId`, an ALB, a target group, a listener, an instance profile chain, RDS in private subnets, an S3 bucket and an export. |
| `web_stack.json` | The same template in long form (`{"Ref": ...}`, `{"Fn::GetAtt": [...]}`), generated by expanding the short-form tags of `web_stack.yaml`, so the long-form path stays testable where the short-form loader is missing. |
| `sam_api.yaml` | A SAM template (`Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31`) with `Globals`, a function with an inline policy, a policy template and `Api` events, a function with `AdministratorAccess` behind an `HttpApi`, and a `SimpleTable`. |
| `resources_only.yaml` | A template with only a `Resources` mapping: no format version, description or parameters. |
| `nested_parent.yaml`, `nested_child.yaml` | A parent stack that includes `AWS::CloudFormation::Stack` and reads a nested output with `!GetAtt Network.Outputs.PrivateSubnetId`. |
